title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season. 
  Resolution Timing : Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.
